This plot is very small, just a corner where I plant my yam and cassava. I am old now, 65 years, and I farm the way my father taught me. Fertilizer from the bag costs too much money for such a small piece of ground — one bag is more than this plot needs and I cannot waste cash like that. I will put the goat droppings and the kitchen ash I gather through the dry season, and I keep my own yam setts from last harvest like I always do. My sons help me make the heaps and my wife helps with weeding, so I do not need to pay anybody.
